language.chooseBody: We noticed you might prefer {{language}}. You can change this any time from the language menu.
language.saveFailed: We could not save your language choice. It is applied here, and we will try again next time you sign in.

emptyBalance.stoppedTitle: Your credit ran out and prepaid deployments were stopped
emptyBalance.paygTitle: Your credit balance is empty — pay-as-you-go is covering your usage
emptyBalance.stoppedBody: Add credit to start them again, or switch them to pay-as-you-go, which keeps running and bills you afterwards.
emptyBalance.willStopBody: Your prepaid deployments will be stopped at the next billing run unless you add credit.
emptyBalance.paygBody: Your pay-as-you-go deployments are still running — that time is still charged, and goes onto your outstanding balance.
emptyBalance.cardRequired: This platform also requires a verified card on file before anything can start again.
emptyBalance.limitTitle: Pay-as-you-go limit reached — your deployments are paused
emptyBalance.limitBody: You owe {{owed}}, which is {{over}} over your limit of {{limit}}, so your pay-as-you-go deployments have been paused.
emptyBalance.limitResume: Add credit to bring your balance back under the limit — they start again automatically.
emptyBalance.tooOldTitle: Payment overdue — your deployments are paused
emptyBalance.tooOldBody_one: Your outstanding balance of {{amount}} has been unpaid for {{count}} day, longer than the {{max}} days allowed, so your pay-as-you-go deployments have been paused.
emptyBalance.tooOldBody_other: Your outstanding balance of {{amount}} has been unpaid for {{count}} days, longer than the {{max}} days allowed, so your pay-as-you-go deployments have been paused.
emptyBalance.tooOldResume: Pay it in full — they start again automatically.
emptyBalance.pausedDiskCharged: Paused deployments keep their disks, and that storage is still charged: {{amount}} a day, added to what you owe.
